info.title: Nombramientos Adventistas local API
info.description: Contrato completo de la API Fastify implementada para el perfil local. Incluye autenticación y MFA, acceso multi-tenant, flujo institucional persistente, custodia E2EE, fotografías cifradas, reportería redactada y administración de plataforma; no declara estabilidad pública ni despliegue de producción.

post.summary: Validate local credentials and start MFA or a session
post.description: Requires the exact canonical browser Origin before credential work. Unknown, password-disabled, and explicitly non-provisioned password identities return the same INVALID_CREDENTIALS response after Argon2id verification work.

post.summary: Verify the bound TOTP challenge or a one-use recovery code
post.description: The server atomically reserves one of at most six challenge attempts before performing TOTP or recovery-code verification. A durable identity-wide fixed-window budget survives newly issued challenges; policy-disabled password-derived factors fail closed.

post.summary: Create a single-display TOTP enrollment after recent authentication
post.description: Requires CSRF and a session authenticated within ten minutes. The plaintext seed and otpauth URI are returned only for this creation response; an active enrollment cannot be replayed.

get.summary: Resume confirmation of a still-valid TOTP enrollment
get.description: Returns only the enrollment identifier and expiry to the same recently authenticated identity and session. The seed and otpauth URI are returned once by start and are never decrypted or replayed. The response is never cacheable.

200.description: Non-secret pending enrollment metadata, or null when none remains

Verify TOTP, rotate the session, and issue hashed one-use recovery codes
post.description: The prior session and recovery-code generation are revoked atomically. Plaintext recovery codes appear only in this no-store response and do not grant or recover E2EE content keys. Replacing an existing fallback factor requires a fresh, one-use, operation-bound passkey grant when the identity has an active passkey or enforced policy requires phishing-resistant authorization; restricted bootstrap and recovery sessions retain the enrollment escape path.

Establish a browser-bound invitation recovery context
post.description: Public, rate-limited and exact-Origin protected. Before any invitation mutation, this endpoint issues or refreshes a 256-bit browser root secret only as a host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie scoped to /v1/invitations. The API derives a distinct invitation proof with HMAC-SHA-256 over token and normalized email; the root is never passed to the service/database, returned in JSON, stored by JavaScript, accepted in a URL, or written to audit data. The cookie survives a tab/browser restart for at most 24 hours and is retained across retryable/concurrent acceptance responses.

200.description: Recovery context prepared; response is no-store

Set-Cookie.description: Host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Strict recovery root scoped to /v1/invitations; Secure is mandatory outside the localhost development profile and Max-Age is at most 86400 seconds.

post.summary: Accept an unexpired one-time tenant invitation
post.description: Public, rate-limited, passkey-first endpoint. It requires the browser-bound HttpOnly recovery context prepared first; the recovery secret is accepted only from that cookie, never from JSON. Invalid, expired, revoked, consumed, recipient-mismatched and unknown tokens return the same neutral error. Password may be omitted; the database atomically requests it only when the current organization policy permits password authentication. Successful acceptance issues a short invitation-bound enrollment-only session and returns its CSRF token; the bearer is delivered only as an HttpOnly cookie.

201.description: Identity, tenant membership, exact invited roles and a database-clamped enrollment-only session were activated atomically

428.description: The secure browser recovery context is missing, or current organization policy requires a password. No invitation is accepted; the recovery workflow remains pending for a safe policy retry.

error.message: A password is required by the current organization policy

post.summary: Create a tenant-scoped invitation
post.description: The tenant is always derived from the authenticated session. Every requested system role must be a subset of the actor's currently delegable tenant permissions, and authorization is revalidated when the invitation is accepted. In the local profile only, the random acceptance token is returned on the first successful request and never on idempotent replay. Production fails closed until an approved delivery channel exists.

x-policy-operation-step-up.enforcedWhen: WebAuthn is required when enforcementMode is enforce or the action policy requires phishing-resistant step-up; recent MFA remains the monitor-mode floor

Every success rotates the prior target session, never creates a normal/admin session, retains supported context roots, and returns no raw session identifier or bearer in JSON.

cookieAuth.name: nom_session
cookieAuth.description: Revocable HttpOnly session cookie. User-agent continuity is enforced; coarse IP changes are recorded as risk signals without breaking legitimate network mobility.

mfaCookie.name: nom_mfa
mfaCookie.description: Short-lived HttpOnly cookie bound to the MFA challenge.

webauthnCookie.name: nom_webauthn_<ceremony-id>
webauthnCookie.description: Short-lived SameSite=Strict HttpOnly cookie selected by the ceremonyId in the request. Its AES-256-GCM envelope is confidential, authenticated, and bound to the exact ceremony id, type, expiry, and cookie name; only the inner token's SHA-256 digest is persisted. Distinct names allow authentication, registration, and step-up ceremonies to coexist across tabs.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: Double-submit token: the header must equal the nom_csrf cookie and its hash must match the authenticated session.

stepUpGrant.name: x-step-up-grant
stepUpGrant.description: Opaque short-lived grant consumed atomically once and bound to identity, session, purpose, method, path and canonical JSON body. Query strings are forbidden on protected mutations.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID scoped to actor, tenant and operation. Reuse with the same canonical body returns the stored result; reuse with another body conflicts.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Safe non-negative SSE sequence used for resumption.

OriginHeader.name: Origin
OriginHeader.description: Must be one of the configured exact browser origins.

StepUpGrantHeader.name: x-step-up-grant
StepUpGrantHeader.description: Opaque one-use operation grant returned by WebAuthn step-up verification.

ContentKeyWriteConflict.description: The authenticated identity has no active grant for the current tenant content-key generation, or at least one submitted AES-GCM envelope names a non-current key. The write is rejected atomically.

error.message: An active tenant key grant is required
Every envelope must use the current tenant key

AssignmentEligibilityPaused.description: The member is no longer operationally eligible for the assignment office, or the write lacks a current tenant content-key grant. Eligibility pauses are committed idempotently before any content-key check because they do not persist the submitted ciphertext; otherwise KEY_GRANT_REQUIRED and ENVELOPE_KEY_MISMATCH reject the encrypted write atomically.

error.message: Assignment eligibility changed; resolve the persisted workflow pause before advancing

Error.description: JSON error response. The concrete HTTP status and stable code depend on the failed precondition.

WebAuthnStepUpRequired.description: The operation requires a fresh passkey assertion. Retry step-up with the exact returned purpose and operationHash, then send the one-use grant.

error.message: A fresh passkey verification is required for this exact operation

token.description: Required for first redemption and optional only for a same-context response-loss retry.

reused.description: True only for an idempotent approval replay; replay never returns a new bearer.

developmentToken.description: Present exactly once on a fresh local development/test approval; never on replay or in production.

ErrorCode.description: Stable upper-snake-case machine code emitted by the selected operation. Each operation documents its domain preconditions; validation and Fastify/plugin failures may additionally map to VALIDATION_ERROR or REQUEST_ERROR.

token.description: One-use token delivered locally; never accepted in the URL.

password.description: Must also exclude common passwords and the normalized email local-part or display-name tokens.

AccessRoleCreateRequest.description: delegablePermissionCodes must be a subset of permissionCodes and all entries must be actor-delegable non-platform permissions.

AccessRoleUpdateRequest.description: delegablePermissionCodes must be a subset of permissionCodes and all entries must be actor-delegable non-platform permissions.

version.description: Exact next immutable history version returned by the write-context endpoint.

MemberPhotoPutRequest.description: width and height must be equal; ciphertext bytes must equal plaintextBytes plus the 16-byte AES-GCM tag, contentHash must match the envelope, and version must match the next immutable history version.

expectedVersion.description: The active photo version, or zero when no active photograph exists.

nextVersion.description: The next append-only version across active and archived photo history.

MemberQualificationStatus.description: Explicit review state. It is not inferred from expiresOn and has no automatic eligibility effect.

MemberQualificationDetailsEnvelope.description: Optional client-encrypted JSON containing only title and issuer. Decoded ciphertext is limited to 2048 bytes. Exact AAD is {tenantId,memberId,qualificationId,purpose:'member-qualification-details',schemaVersion:1,version,type,status,effectiveOn,expiresOn}. keyId identifies the exact generation: new writes require the current active lifecycle grant, while authorized clients may retain retired generation keys in session memory to read immutable history. Missing or invalid decrypted details degrade to unavailable rather than being trusted.

effectiveOn.description: Civil date; no timezone conversion is performed.

MemberQualificationCreateRequest.description: detailsEnvelope and detailsContentHash must both be non-null or both null. expiresOn cannot precede effectiveOn, and status expired requires expiresOn. Clear title or issuer properties are rejected.

effectiveOn.description: Civil date; no timezone conversion is performed.

MemberQualificationRevisionRequest.description: The server appends expectedVersion + 1. Details pairing, dates, AES-256-GCM size and exact AAD rules are identical to creation; clear narrative fields are rejected.

eligibilityInference.description: Stable guard: this register never implies automatic eligibility.

termEnd.description: Must be on or after termStart.

sessionId.description: Client-generated identifier used before encryption in the exact title AAD.

titleEnvelope.description: E2EE session-title envelope. AAD must be exactly {tenantId,cycleId,sessionId,purpose:'session-title',schemaVersion:1,titleVersion:1}.

titleContentHash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the complete canonical title envelope.

titleEnvelope.description: Replacement E2EE title. AAD must use the exact session context and titleVersion equal to the current titleVersion plus one; unrelated entity updates do not change titleVersion.

itemId.description: Client-generated identifier used before encryption in the exact title AAD.

titleEnvelope.description: E2EE agenda-title envelope. AAD must be exactly {tenantId,sessionId,agendaItemId,purpose:'session-agenda-title',schemaVersion:1,titleVersion:1}.

titleVersion.description: Independent title-envelope version. Zero is reserved for redacted legacy rows.

legacyTitleUnavailable.description: True only when a pre-E2EE plaintext title was irreversibly neutralized during migration.

titleVersion.description: Independent title-envelope version. Zero is reserved for redacted legacy rows.

WorkflowReportMetrics.description: Metrics for the selected cycle. coveragePercent is null when vacanciesTotal is zero. Church projections contain only vacanciesTotal and congregationallyElected.

WorkflowReportOrganizationItem.description: Cycle-scoped vacancy/assignment projection. Church output masks non-elected appointments as vacant and removes their member snapshot.

WorkflowReportSession.description: Internal audiences receive the opaque E2EE title trio for authorized browser decryption. Church output omits the trio and uses neutral sequence labels.

WorkflowReportAgendaItem.description: Internal audiences receive the opaque agenda-title trio; church output omits it.

officeId.description: Catalog office identifier. Catalogability does not imply eligibility for the ordinary proposal/ballot workflow; council_recommendation_board_approval requires a separate validated procedure.

ProposalAggregateRequest.description: The effective denominator is the number of valid non-empty plaintext responses computed client-side after verifying the ordered manifest. Each support count must not exceed it. Participation remains a separate completed/required pair.

ApproveGrantIntent.description: A sealed grant for either the active generation or one exact retired generation. Retired delegation never activates a pending device and is persisted with retired status.

tenantKeyId.description: Exact tenant content-key identifier of the active or retired generation being delegated.

generation.description: Exact positive generation number bound into the grant envelope AAD.

required.description: Frozen, non-recused electorate denominator for this exact round.

received.description: Participation receipts matching this round's submission kind.

vacanciesTotal.description: Applicable vacancies in this department, including legacy vacancies without a process.

decisions.description: Persisted institutional decisions whose denominator is agendaItems for this session.

membersTotal.description: Current non-archived member roster at the persisted dashboard update.

eligibleReference.description: Eligible population frozen for the selected cycle; it is not the current member roster.

roundParticipation.description: Latest applicable round per submission kind; denominators remain round-scoped and are never summed.

sessions.description: Non-cancelled sessions only; contains counts and no encrypted or nominal content.

updatedAt.description: Latest persisted mutation timestamp among the tenant, active cycle, current roster, catalog labels, applicable workflow, rounds, assignments, and non-cancelled session sources used by this dashboard; repeated reads do not advance it.

replacementCredentialId.description: An active credential owned by the identity to revoke only after the new passkey is verified and stored atomically.

email.description: Accepted for backward wire compatibility but deliberately ignored to prevent account enumeration.

options.description: W3C PublicKeyCredential creation or request options encoded as JSON.

id.description: Internal opaque credential record id; the WebAuthn credential id and public key are never returned.

operationHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical version, purpose, uppercase method, query-free path and recursively key-sorted JSON body.

userAgentContextChanged.description: Known for the current session; null for other inventory entries when the server intentionally omits this signal.

IdentityPolicyValues.description: Privileged minimum AAL/passkey counts must not be below ordinary minimums; all passkey minimums must fit maximumPasskeys. Authentication method toggles are immediate controls and updates that disable one are rejected until tenant-wide readiness can be proven. Enforce-mode AAL3, device-bound and attestation requirements are rejected until the deployment has a supported trust and break-glass path.

enforcementMode.description: Controls assurance compliance targets only. Monitor mode reports findings and does not request direct attestation; explicit method allow/deny, cryptographic verification and session controls always enforce.

privilegedMinimumPasskeyCount.description: Must be greater than or equal to minimumPasskeyCount and no greater than maximumPasskeys.

timezone.description: Persisted IANA timezone of the active tenant.

secret.description: Single-display TOTP seed; never persisted in plaintext.

otpauthUri.description: Single-display enrollment URI; clients must not place it in browser URLs or persistent storage.

recoveryCodes.description: Single-display, one-use codes. Only Argon2id hashes persist.

password.description: Optional for passkey-first onboarding. If current organization policy requires password authentication, omission returns retryable INVITATION_PASSWORD_REQUIRED. When accepted, requires lowercase, uppercase, number and symbol and must not contain recipient/name identifiers.

reasonCode.description: Optional non-sensitive operational code; human justification belongs in an encrypted evidence envelope.

acceptanceToken.description: Present exactly once, only in a non-production local profile.

nonce.description: Decoded length is 12 bytes for AES-256-GCM and 24 bytes for XCHACHA20-POLY1305.

ciphertext.description: Decoded ciphertext including authentication tag must be at least 16 bytes.

aad.description: Base64url JSON context validated against the route and tenant.

contactEnvelope.description: Optional member-contact/v1 envelope. Supplying it requires member.contact.manage.

departmentRestriction.description: Exact active department ID used for office eligibility. Null means unrestricted across departments. Names and encrypted private notes are never enforcement inputs.

validUntil.description: Inclusive tenant civil date evaluated using the tenant time zone. Null means no automatic expiry.

contactEnvelope.description: Optional independently authorized member-contact/v1 replacement; null removes contact.

resolveLegacyProfile.description: When true, requires member.contact.manage, displayEnvelope, and an explicit contactEnvelope or null. The quarantined legacy combined envelope is irreversibly cleared atomically.

departmentRestriction.description: Exact active department ID used for office eligibility. Null clears the restriction and means unrestricted across departments.

validUntil.description: Inclusive tenant civil date evaluated using the tenant time zone. Null clears the date and means no automatic expiry.

reasonCode.description: Non-sensitive closed operational vocabulary retained in the audit chain.

displayEnvelope.description: Required for create/update and prohibited for skip. Contains display identity only, using exact member-display/v1 AAD.

MemberImportColumnMapping.description: Zero-based source column indexes. Columns are unique; map displayName or both firstName and lastName.

sourceFileName.description: Generic format marker; the local filename is never uploaded.

sourceSheetName.description: Opaque fingerprint of the locally selected sheet name.

AppointmentMechanism.description: Catalog classification only. Ordinary proposal/ballot eligibility is allowlisted separately; council_recommendation_board_approval is catalogable but cannot enter that workflow.

displayName.description: Display name of the tenant/church, not a localized catalog label.

payload.description: Allowlisted scalar fields for the named event; never the raw outbox row.
